battle.name: 第二次英阿戰爭
battle.brief: 一八七八年英軍三路入侵阿富汗，攻入喀布爾、逼簽甘達馬克條約；一八七九至八〇年再戰，羅伯茨自喀布爾急行軍三百英里，於坎大哈擊敗穆罕默德汗。整場戰爭在內陸展開，卡面這艘一八六二年式鐵甲艦未曾現身，卻是英國造船工業與航運的後盾；地面火力改由九點四五吋前裝線膛重砲與海軍旅的七磅砲承擔。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的兩方是英國與阿富汗王國，兩邊的國家結構幾乎是兩種極端。英方是英屬印度陸軍為主幹、皇家海軍為支架的帝國戰爭機器：政治上由印度總督利頓勳爵坐鎮，軍事上由駐印度總司令約翰·斯圖爾特爵士統率，第一階段投入三路縱隊——克蘇姆河谷縱隊、喀布爾縱隊與坎大哈縱隊，另有工兵、皇家馬砲兵、皇家砲兵、通信、醫務與輜重等兵種；第二階段則幾乎由羅伯茨一人主導。英國皇家海軍在這場戰爭裡的任務不是作戰，而是維持海上動脈：東印度分遣隊與波斯灣分遣隊（先後由休厄特與霍普指揮）封鎖印度河河口、護航運兵與補給船隊，並從艦上抽調海軍旅隨陸軍進入阿富汗山道。阿方是喀布爾的艾米爾政府，軍權分成兩層：中央軍隊由艾米爾直接調遣，裝備落後、紀律鬆散；各部落的武裝由首領率領，靠劫掠與襲擾作戰，效忠隨局勢轉移。阿富汗是內陸國，既無海軍，也沒有可用的內河航運，全國補給靠陸路與商隊，戰爭勝負便落在誰能更快地運人運糧、誰能守住山口。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the British Empire and the Kingdom of Afghanistan, and the two state structures were almost exact opposites. On the British side the instrument of war was the Indian Army, propped up by the Royal Navy: politically the viceroy, Lord Lytton, sat at the top, and militarily the Commander-in-Chief in India, Sir John Stewart, held command. The first phase put three columns in the field, the Kurram column, the Kabul column and the Kandahar column, together with the engineers, the Royal Horse Artillery, the Royal Artillery, the signal and medical services and the transport train; the second phase was run almost single-handedly by Roberts. The Royal Navy's task in this war was not to fight but to keep the sea artery open. The East Indies Station and the Persian Gulf Division, under Rear-Admiral Hewett and afterwards Rear-Admiral Hope, enforced the blockade of the mouth of the Indus, escorted the troop and supply transports, and detached naval brigades from their ships to serve with the army in the Afghan hills. On the Afghan side stood the emiral's government at Kabul, with military power in two layers: a central army commanded directly by the emir, ill equipped and slack in discipline, and tribal levies led by their own chiefs who fought by plunder and harassment and whose loyalty shifted with the situation. Afghanistan was a landlocked country with no navy and no usable river navigation of its own; everything moved by road and by caravan, so the whole war came down to who could move men and food faster, and who could hold the passes.
people: 關鍵人物幾乎全在英方，因為阿方缺少能改變局面的指揮者。指揮全盤的是弗雷德里克·羅伯茨（一八三二至一九一四，後封卡夫卡爾的羅伯茨男爵）：一八七八年他以准將身份率克蘇姆縱隊，九月二十五日在艾哈邁德凱勒擊敗穆罕默德·阿克巴爾汗，十月攻入加茲尼；一八七九年十二月十八日再以第二次查拉西亞之役決定性地打開喀布爾；一八八〇年八月率軍自喀布爾急行軍三百英里，九月七日於坎大哈擊敗穆罕默德汗，翌年封為卡夫卡爾男爵，日後兩度出任參謀總長。英軍最高統帥是駐印度總司令約翰·斯圖爾特爵士，一八七八至八一年在任；第一階段的坎大哈縱隊由奧德耶爵士率領。海上那條線由休厄特與霍普掌舵：休厄特主持波斯灣分遣隊，封鎖印度河，把阿方可能的外部補給掐斷。阿方一連串艾米爾輪番登場，謝爾·阿里、薩德克汗、穆罕默德·雅庫布汗，最後是阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼汗——他於一八八〇年自北方回到喀布爾即位，此後二十年的對英政策全由他定調。士兵也有名字：坎大哈駐地保衛戰中整頓第廿四旁遮普步兵團、扭轉戰局的阿爾巴布·賈漢汗與賈馬達爾·庫達達德汗；一八七八年加茲尼兵變中與工兵一同陣亡的孟加拉第二輕騎兵與旁遮普工兵；一八七九年第二次查拉西亞之役中，在沒有砲兵支援下頂住阿軍騎兵衝擊的第七孟加拉步兵營。
peopleEn: The decisive figures are almost all British, because the Afghan side produced no commander capable of turning the war. The man in charge was Frederick Roberts (1832-1914), later Baron Roberts of Kandahar: in 1878 he led the Kurram column as a major-general, beat Muhammad Akbar Khan at Ahmed Khel on 25 September and entered Ghazni in October; on 18 December 1879 he opened Kabul with the second battle of Charasiab; in August 1880 he marched his army three hundred miles out of Kabul and destroyed Muhammad Khan at the battle of Kandahar on 7 September; he was made Baron Roberts of Kandahar the following year and twice served afterwards as Chief of the Imperial General Staff. The British supreme commander was Sir John Stewart, Commander-in-Chief in India from 1878 to 1881, and Sir Michael O'Dwyer led the Kandahar column in the first phase. The line at sea was run by Hewett and Hope: Hewett commanded the Persian Gulf Division, blockaded the Indus and cut off the outside supplies on which the Afghans might otherwise have relied. On the Afghan side the emirs came and went in turn, Sher Ali, Sadeq Khan, Muhammad Yaqub Khan, and finally Abdur Rahman Khan, who came back from the north to Kabul in 1880, was enthroned there, and set the anti-British policy of the twenty years that followed. Soldiers have names too: Arbab Jahan Khan and Jamadar Khudadad Khan, who rallied the 24th Punjab Native Infantry and turned the fighting during the defence of the Kandahar Residency; the men of the 2nd Bengal Light Horse and the Sappers and Miners who were killed at Ghazni in the mutiny of 1878; and the 7th Bengal Native Infantry, which at the second battle of Charasiab in 1879 stood against Afghan cavalry with no artillery support of its own.
kits: 卡面是一艘一八六二年式的英國鐵甲艦：木殼外面包了鐵，裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。有一件事必須先說清楚——第二次英阿戰爭在內陸，喀布爾與坎大哈之間沒有海，阿富汗連像樣的內河船隊都沒有，鐵甲艦本身從未參加過這場戰爭。它在這場戰爭裡的位置在後方：它代表英國的造船工業與帝國航線。真正走進阿富汗山道的海軍力量只有兩種：一是海軍旅，由東印度分遣隊與波斯灣分遣隊抽調的藍衣水兵與海軍陸戰隊，攜帶七磅砲與火箭筒，據當時作戰記錄是隨羅伯茨的坎大哈縱隊行軍作戰的；二是維持印度河河口封鎖、護航與偵察的螺旋槳砲艦、汽艇與武裝小船。英軍能在喜馬拉雅山麓推進數百英里，靠的正是海軍控制的運兵船與糧秣船隊，而這條航線背後的技術基礎與那些鐵甲艦完全共用：埃爾斯威克兵工廠在一八六二年建成投產，往後既造英國第一批現代主力鐵甲艦，也造出後膛線膛砲。地面上真正扮演火力核心的是英軍自己的重砲——九點四五吋七噸重前裝線膛砲與七吋前裝線膛砲，前者在一八七九年進攻喀布爾時對巴拉希薩爾堡壘做長距離砲擊，四十磅與六十四磅前裝線膛砲用於中距離支援，皇家馬砲兵另帶康格里夫火箭筒與七磅、九磅野砲；步兵主力是一八七九年式李-恩菲爾德步槍，與仍在前線服役的馬丁尼-亨利、斯奈德-恩菲爾德並用，佩劍為一八七六式重騎兵劍與一八七八式步兵劍，輔以刺刀、矛、帳篷與毛氈。工程與運輸才是這場戰爭的真正主角：皇家工兵挖掘坑道、架設浮橋、在荒山中鋪設電報線；運載靠騾、馬、牛車與徵用的駱駝。阿軍的裝備停在另一個時代：長身燧發槍、前裝火帽槍，少量改裝的英制來福槍，固定砲台上的老式青銅滑膛砲，喀布爾的火藥庫與圍城儲糧；一八八〇年馬伊萬德一役的砲隊約十二門，口徑與制式混雜，線膛砲與前裝滑膛砲並列，砲陣佈置與射擊紀律都遠遜英軍。
kitsEn: The card shows an ironclad of the British type of 1862: a wooden hull cased in iron, armour for the first time harder to defeat than guns, and gun turret design thereafter turning around it. One thing has to be said plainly first. The Second Anglo-Afghan War was fought inland; there is no sea between Kabul and Kandahar, Afghanistan had not even a usable river fleet, and no ironclad ever took part in this war. Its place in the war was in the rear: it stands for British shipbuilding industry and for the imperial sea lane. Only two kinds of naval force actually walked into the Afghan hills. The first was the naval brigade, bluejackets and marines detached from the East Indies Station and the Persian Gulf Division, carrying seven-pounder guns and rocket tubes and, according to the campaign records, serving on the march with Roberts's Kandahar column. The second was the small steam gunboats, launches and armed boats that maintained the blockade of the Indus and escorted and scouted the convoys. That the British could push several hundred miles along the foot of the Himalayas rested on the troop and supply shipping kept moving by the Navy, and the industrial base behind that lane was shared with the ironclads themselves: the Elswick Works of William Armstrong was opened for production in 1862 and afterwards built both the first modern capital ironclads for the Royal Navy and the new rifled breech-loaders. The real centre of British firepower on the ground was the army's own heavy artillery, the nine-and-a-half-inch seven-ton rifle muzzle-loader and the seven-inch rifle muzzle-loader, the former delivering long-range fire against the Bala Hissar works during the advance on Kabul in 1879, with forty-pounder and sixty-four-pounder rifles muzzle-loaders for intermediate support, while the Royal Horse Artillery brought Congreve rocket tubes and seven- and nine-pounder field guns. Infantry were armed mainly with the 1879 Pattern Lee-Enfield rifle, served alongside the Martini-Henry and the Snider-Enfield still in the line, and carried the 1876 Pattern heavy cavalry sword and the 1878 Pattern infantry sword, with bayonets, spears, tents and felt blankets. Engineering and transport were the real protagonists of this war: the Royal Engineers dug saps, built floating bridges and ran telegraph lines through empty mountain country; movement depended on mules, horses, bullock carts and requisitioned camels. The Afghan equipment belonged to an earlier age: long-barrelled jezail matchlocks and percussion muzzle-loaders, a few converted British rifles, old bronze smoothbores in fixed emplacements, the powder magazine and siege stores at Kabul; the Afghan battery at Maiwand in 1880 numbered about a dozen pieces of mixed calibres and types, rifled and smoothbored side by side, and both their deployment and their gun discipline fell far short of the British.
tactics: 英軍的打法可用四個詞概括：分進合擊、遠程砲火、強制行軍與嚴格的補給線。第一階段是典型的三路平推：一八七八年二月十九日利頓向謝爾·阿里發出最後通牒，三月初部隊自印度河下游與白沙瓦分道，十二月二十一日第二旅攻下開伯爾山口的阿里清真寺，四月底第一份甘達馬克條約簽訂後大軍直入喀布爾，代價則是一八七八年九月二十三日的加茲尼兵變——孟加拉第二輕騎兵與旁遮普工兵在府邸被屠，英軍自此把第二階段的戰事當成清算來打，羅伯茨第二次查拉西亞之役的目標正是摧毀阿軍主力。一八八〇年的戰術核心是行軍：八月六日自喀布爾出發，縱隊只帶十日口糧，沿洛加爾河谷與阿爾甘達布河谷翻越科賈克山口，二十一晝夜行軍約三百英里，於九月七日趕到坎大哈城下，正好在阿富汗軍猛攻駐地的第五天解圍。行軍紀律嚴到殘酷，沿途阿富汗村莊一律焚燒以斷敵給養，臨陣脫逃者就地處決，後隊由騾隊輸送口糧與傷病員。阿軍的打法則完全是另一路：以部族游擊與襲擾拖住縱隊，以山寨與城牆死守，盡量避開英軍九點四五吋重砲的有效射程，把兵力和糧食集中在坎大哈與赫拉特兩處重點，最後以兩萬人以上的兵力在平原上正面決戰，卻輸在沒有可對等的砲兵，指揮也不統一。
tacticsEn: The British method can be summed up in four words: converging advance, long-range artillery, forced marching and a strict supply line. The first phase was a three-column push of the classic kind. On 19 February 1878 Lytton sent Sher Ali his ultimatum; the columns went in from the lower Indus and from Peshawar in early March; on 21 December the second brigade stormed Ali Masjid in the Khyber Pass; after the first Treaty of Gandamak was signed at the end of April the main body walked into Kabul. The price was the mutiny at Ghazni on 23 September 1878, when the 2nd Bengal Light Horse and the Sappers and Miners were massacred in the Residency, and from that moment the British fought the second phase as a reckoning: the object of Roberts's second battle of Charasiab was to destroy the Afghan army as a fighting force. The tactical heart of 1880 was the march. The column left Kabul on 6 August with only ten days of rations, climbed the Logar and the Arghandab valleys and crossed the Khojak Pass, marched about three hundred miles in twenty-one days, and stood before Kandahar on 7 September, in time to relieve the Residency on the fifth day of the Afghan assault. Discipline on that march was savage: every Afghan village on the line was burnt to cut the enemy's supplies, deserters were shot on the spot, and the rear was carried by mule trains bringing rations and the wounded. The Afghan method was the exact opposite: harassment and tribal harassment to hold the columns up, village strongholds and walled positions held on the defensive, deliberate avoidance of the effective range of the nine-and-a-half-inch guns, men and food concentrated on Kandahar and Herat, and finally a set-piece battle on the plain with more than twenty thousand men, which was lost for want of comparable artillery and of unified command.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。英方第一階段投入的兵力約四萬人，分三路縱隊與龐大後勤；羅伯茨一八八〇年的坎大哈縱隊約九千人，配馬匹約五千、騾子約四千，這正是二十一晝夜三百英里這句話的物質基礎。作戰地域的日期也可逐一對照：開伯爾山口的阿里清真寺在一八七八年十二月二十一日淪陷；加茲尼兵變在九月二十三日；第一次與第二次查拉西亞之役分別是十月二十日（一八七八）與十二月十八日（一八七九）；馬伊萬德戰役在七月二十七日（一八八〇），英軍遠征縱隊約三千人，陣亡人數在一千上下；坎大哈駐地遭猛攻在八月三十日；英軍主力抵達坎大哈在九月七日；第一份甘達馬克條約簽於一八七八年五月二日，第二份簽於一八八〇年四月二十六日，「不再有戰爭」的電訊在五月三日傳到喀布爾。坎大哈戰役中，阿軍集結兵力各說在兩萬至三萬之間，砲約十二門，英軍約八千至九千人。英印軍在整場戰爭中的作戰陣亡約一千六百人、受傷約三千六百人，統計口徑不一；一八八〇年十二月自坎大哈撤回喀布爾的九千人中，死於嚴寒與饑餓者約四千人。加茲尼兵變中陣亡的英軍與阿富汗軍人數各約一百一十上下。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The British committed about forty thousand men in the first phase, spread across three columns and an enormous train; Roberts's Kandahar column in 1880 numbered about nine thousand men with roughly five thousand horses and four thousand mules, and that was the material basis of the phrase about three hundred miles in twenty-one days. The dates of the operations can be checked one by one: Ali Masjid in the Khyber Pass fell on 21 November 1878; the mutiny at Ghazni came on 23 September; the first and second battles of Charasiab were fought on 20 October 1878 and 18 December 1879; the battle of Maiwand was on 27 July 1880, when a British column of about three thousand men lost roughly a thousand dead; the Residency was assaulted on 30 August; the main British force stood before Kandahar on 7 September; the first Treaty of Gandamak was signed on 2 May 1878 and the second on 26 April 1880, and the telegram announcing that there would be no more war reached Kabul on 3 May. At the battle of Kandahar the Afghan force is given at anywhere between twenty and thirty thousand men with about a dozen guns, against eight to nine thousand British and Indian troops. British and Indian losses in the war are put at about one thousand six hundred dead and three thousand six hundred wounded, the counts differing by source; of the nine thousand who left Kandahar for Kabul in December 1880, about four thousand died of cold and hunger. The British and Afghan soldiers killed at the Ghazni mutiny number about a hundred and ten each.
cause: 起因有遠近兩層。近層是一八七八年二月十九日印度總督利頓向艾米爾謝爾·阿里發出的最後通牒，條件包括交出邊境幾個部族、接納英國代表駐喀布爾；謝爾·阿里既不肯交人，也不肯讓步，這份通牒把一次外交僵局變成了開戰的程式。背後是一八四二年第一次英阿戰爭的記憶——那年自喀布爾撤退的一萬六千五百名軍人中，只有布賴登一人走到賈拉巴德，這個故事還在英國兵的家族裡流傳；而在蘇伊士運河落成與信德鐵路、印度河航線打通之後，英國的補給速度已經改變，遠征的成本第一次低到值得重新計算。遠層是地緣：一八七八年三月俄土戰爭以聖斯特凡諾條約收場，俄國在裏海以東的影響力上升，英國對俄羅斯勢力經中亞南抵印度、把喀布爾變成自家後院的憂慮加劇，於是把阿富汗當成印度北面的屏障來經營。阿方也有自己的算計：謝爾·阿里想用現代化換取英國承認並對付赫拉特與坎大哈的割據，卻在國際上愈陷孤立。至於第二階段的直接引信，是英國組成的喀布爾使團與薩德克汗本人同時對頭：一八七九年春薩德克汗被廢、雅庫布汗即位，卻被更激進的部族與赫拉特的反叛逼到絕境，戰爭於是再起，變成阿方要重建中央軍與英方要第二次扶植艾米爾的對撞。
causeEn: The causes work at two distances. The near one is the ultimatum of 19 February 1878, in which the viceroy Lytton demanded of Emir Sher Ali that he hand over several frontier tribes and receive a British mission in Kabul. Sher Ali would neither give up the people nor give way, and the ultimatum turned a diplomatic stalemate into a form for starting a war. Behind it lies the memory of the first Anglo-Afghan War: of the sixteen thousand five hundred soldiers who walked out of Kabul in 1842, only William Brydon reached Jalalabad, and the story was still told in British soldiers' families; and once the Suez Canal had opened and the Sind railway and the Indus river route were working, the speed of British supply had changed and the cost of a distant expedition had for the first time fallen low enough to be worth counting again. The distant cause is geography. The Russo-Turkish War ended with the Treaty of San Stefano in March 1878, Russian influence east of the Caspian rose, and British anxiety that Russian influence would move south through Central Asia and turn Kabul into a back door of India grew, so Afghanistan was run as a shield on the northern frontier of India. The Afghans had their own arithmetic: Sher Ali wanted modernisation in exchange for British recognition and a handle on the separatism of Herat and Kandahar, and found themselves more and more isolated internationally. The immediate spark of the second phase was the British Kabul mission and the emir himself coming into collision: in the spring of 1879 Sadeq Khan was deposed and Yaqub Khan put on the throne, only to be driven to the wall by more militant tribes and by the revolt at Herat, and the war began again as a collision between an Afghan state trying to rebuild a central army and a British government trying to install an emiral for the second time.
impact: 影響可以分三層看。對阿富汗，第一份甘達馬克條約把外交權交給英國，等於把一個內陸國家的對外政策變成別人的附屬；此後二十多年，英國的顧問團與駐軍從未真正撤走。一八八〇年阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼汗即位，阿富汗進入他長達二十年的封閉時期，喀布爾同時維持著英軍顧問團與禁行外人的關卡，形成既臣服又封閉的畸形秩序；一八七九年他在喀布爾召集的阿夫干人民議會雖以反抗為口號，卻同時宣布以宗教法為治國依據，塑造了此後阿國長久的保守走向。對英國，這場戰爭是帝國防衛的前哨：它把「西北邊界」從一句話變成常備軍、封鎖線與補給制度的整套安排，之後印度每年都要為這條邊界花掉可觀的軍費與運力；代價則是一八八〇年冬天退回喀布爾時九千人中約四千人死在雪裡，這個數字此後長期被拿來質問遠征政策的性價比。戰爭也把英國正式帶進中亞的內陸外交，一八七九年之後英俄在喀布爾的競逐、八十年代對赫拉特的爭奪、九十年代俄國在帕米爾的推進，都以這場戰爭劃下的線為起點。而在技術層面，這是一場前裝線膛重砲的頂點演出：九點四五吋砲對付堡壘幾乎無往不利，撤退與追擊時卻顯出射速慢、不能分解的弱點，而同一批英軍手裡已經有了後膛線膛砲與康格里夫火箭，卻沒有足以取代前裝重砲的野戰口徑——這種裝備世代的落後，與海上工業的更新速度形成對比，也正是英國敢於把大量兵力派往內陸的底氣所在。
impactEn: The consequences can be read at three levels. For Afghanistan, the first Treaty of Gandamak handed foreign policy to Britain, which amounted to reducing the external affairs of a landlocked country to a dependency; and for more than twenty years afterwards the British adviser and the British garrison never truly left. When Abdur Rahman Khan was enthroned in 1880 Afghanistan entered the closed period of his two decades, Kabul carrying at once a British advisory staff and the checkpoints that kept foreigners out, an arrangement both subordinate and sealed; the loya jirga he summoned at Kabul in 1879 proclaimed resistance but at the same time made religious law the basis of government, setting the conservative course the country would follow for a long time. For Britain this war was the outpost of imperial defence: it turned the phrase north-west frontier into a whole apparatus of regular troops, blockades and supply lines, and India went on spending considerable money and transport on that frontier every year; the price was paid in the winter of 1880, when about four thousand of the nine thousand who retreated towards Kabul died in the snow, a number long afterwards used to question what a distant expedition was worth. The war also carried Britain formally into the interior diplomacy of Central Asia: the Anglo-Russian competition at Kabul after 1879, the struggle over Herat in the eighties and the Russian advance in the Pamirs in the nineties all start from the line this war drew. At the level of technology the campaign was the high performance of the rifled muzzle-loading heavy gun: the nine-and-a-half-inch piece was almost irresistible against works, but on the retreat and in pursuit its slow rate of fire and its inability to be broken down showed through, and although the same army already had rifled breech-loaders and Congreve rockets it had no field calibre that could replace the old heavy piece. That gap in equipment generations, set against the rate at which the maritime industry could renew itself, was the confidence with which Britain dared to send tens of thousands of men inland.
result: 結果分兩段看。第一階段：一八七八年英軍攻入喀布爾，謝爾·阿里出走，薩德克汗被立為艾米爾，同年五月二日簽訂甘達馬克條約，規定放棄赫拉特與西界據點、交出吉茲尼、外交權歸英國。第二階段：一八七九年羅伯茨打贏第二次查拉西亞，喀布爾再入英軍之手，薩德克汗被廢、雅庫布汗被扶；一八八〇年雅庫布汗被廢、阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼汗即位，赫拉特的反叛席捲全國，馬伊萬德一役英軍慘敗，坎大哈被圍，駐地在八月三十日遭猛攻而未失守；九月七日羅伯茨大軍開到，坎大哈之役阿軍崩潰，穆罕默德汗戰死，大批人馬沿赫拉特方向潰散，英軍一路追擊到坎大哈西南。至此四月的第二份甘達馬克條約才真正落到實處，五月初傳到喀布爾的「不再有戰爭」電訊才有了兵力的註腳。戰爭在實務上於一八八〇年底至一八八一年初以英軍撤退告終，英軍主力退出喀布爾，只留下一支顧問團。以兵器史看，這是一場前裝線膛重砲的壓倒性勝利，也是海軍旅與火箭第一次成規模地隨軍深入山區；它同時證明，靠帝國海運與艦隊支撐的遠征能贏下每一場會戰，卻贏不了一個願意在雪裡死掉四千人也要重整旗鼓的國家。
resultEn: The result reads in two stages. In the first, the British army entered Kabul in 1878, Sher Ali went into exile, Sadeq Khan was set up as emir, and on 2 May of that year the Treaty of Gandamak was signed, giving up Herat and the western outposts, surrendering Ghazni, and handing foreign policy to Britain. In the second, Roberts won the second battle of Charasiab in 1879, Kabul fell into British hands again, Sadeq Khan was deposed and Yaqub Khan put up in his place; in 1880 Yaqub was removed in turn and Abdur Rahman Khan was set on the throne, the revolt at Herat swept the country, the British were beaten at Maiwand, Kandahar was invested, and on 30 August the Residency was assaulted hard and held. On 7 September Roberts's army came up, the Afghan army broke at the battle of Kandahar, Muhammad Khan was killed, and a mass of men broke towards Herat while the British pursued as far as the ground south-west of Kandahar. Only then did the April Treaty of Gandamak take real effect, and only then did the telegram announcing that there would be no more war, which reached Kabul in early May, have a force behind it. The war was wound up in practice by the British withdrawal between the end of 1880 and the beginning of 1881, the main body leaving Kabul and nothing but an advisory staff remaining. Judged as a page in the history of weapons, this was an overwhelming victory for the rifled muzzle-loading heavy gun, and the first time that naval brigades and rockets went deep into the hills in company with an army. At the same time it proved that an expedition propped up by imperial shipping and by squadrons could win every battle it fought, but could not win against a country prepared to lose four thousand men in the snow and set itself in order again.
